name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
✨ What's new since v2.5.6

🔐 Settings access tiers — Project settings are now split into «Planning» and «Administration» groups. Workflow-rule configuration (DTA, cascade aggregation, container-work ban, State Rollup) and access-rights groups are editable only by the settings manager; a new «Planning settings manager» group lets you delegate planning settings (roles, fields, norms, modes) without granting workflow access.

🎭 Per-role sprint status — Sprint status is now tracked independently for each role: lowering one role's status (e.g. via the overlimit downgrade) no longer affects the others, per-role status badges update immediately, and the composition lock is per-role too.

🐞 History & planning fixes — The «Allocation» and «Assignee» columns are back in sprint-history records; sprint intro fields (name / dates / goal) now populate on a cold load; the «Reset draft» button reliably clears the server draft; the working-copy banner and indicator hide when no working copy is active.

♿ Accessibility — Sprint-history record headers are now keyboard-operable (Enter / Space) and announced as expandable buttons by screen readers; the pick-assignees toast no longer shows doubled punctuation. Button labels now match their spoken names — the «Pick assignees», «Calculate resource», «Refresh from task» and «Clear» buttons are announced by screen readers and recognized by voice input exactly as they read on screen (WCAG 2.5.3 «Label in Name»).

🛠 Under the hood — Widget source reorganized into architecture layers (domain / infra / pure / data / i18n) with automated fitness checks guarding the structure; the test suite moved to Node's built-in runner (node --test: unit + golden, no browser) with GitHub Actions CI and a CONTRIBUTING guide. The runtime bundle is byte-identical — a pure internal refactor. The personal-planning data model is now unified onto per-role history snapshots as the single source of truth, eliminating a latent keyed-vs-single form mismatch in persistence (no user-visible change).

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss. Existing project settings (roles, fields, manager group) are reused as-is.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), estimate and spent fields, planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project.
